shareholding.remarks_web: During the quarter ended December 31, 2024, the Company had filed the re-classification application with the Stock Exchanges seeking re-classification of Mr. Parag Joglekar, Mrs. Pinky Mehta and Mr. A. Balasubramanian from Promoter and Promoter Group to Public Shareholder category. Accordingly, the stock exchanges vide their letters dated December 27, 2024 had granted approval for the said re-classification

shareholding.remarks_web: A. 512 Equity Shares, 416 Equity Shares and 192 Equity Shares each  held by Mr. Parag Yashwant Joglekar, Mr. Balasubramanian Athmanathan and Ms. Pinky Mehta, respectively, as nominees of Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) are transferred to ABCL during the quarter ended September 30, 2024. B. As on September 30, 2024, Mr. Kumar Mangalam Birla held 44.97% significant beneficial interest in the Company i.e. 12,96,43,873(44.97%) equity shares of the Company held by Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL).

shareholding.remarks_web: A. 512 Equity Shares, 416 Equity Shares and 192 Equity Shares each are held by Mr. Parag Yashwant Joglekar, Mr. Balasubramanian Athmanathan and Ms. Pinky Mehta, respectively, as nominees of Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL).
